title: A look at London-based AI startup Cosine, which is building a frontier model with UK government backing, as some question if it has the talent and resources (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: A look at London-based AI startup Cosine, which is building a frontier model with UK government backing, as some question if it has the talent and resources — Britain's bid to build a “sovereign” AI model rests with a London start-up of about 30 employees that has raised just $15mn.
